title: qatars first quarter gdp falls 7 iran war weighs energy production 2026 08 31
text:
DUBAI, Aug 31 (Reuters) - Qatar's economy shrank 7% in the first-quarter of 2026 from a year earlier, dragged down by a ​sharp decline in energy production caused by the ongoing ‌Middle East conflict, official data showed.
Qatar, one of the world's largest liquefied natural gas exporters, has suffered major disruptions to production and ranks among ​the economies hardest hit by the conflict.
